jobs.title: Backend Developer Intern (APIs, Databases, Server-Side Logic)
jobs.description:
Backend Developer Intern (APIs, Databases, Server-Side Logic)
Remote (India) | Full-Time Internship | Duration: 1–3 Months

About Medinex Workforce
Medinex Workforce partners with organizations across data, technology, and healthcare-adjacent industries to build strong early-career talent pipelines. Our internship program is built around real project work, direct mentorship, and measurable skill development.

Role Overview
We're bringing on a Backend Developer Intern to support our remote engineering team. You'll get hands-on exposure to building the server-side logic, APIs, and databases that power our applications.

Key Responsibilities
- Help develop and maintain server-side application logic
- Support design and implementation of RESTful APIs
- Work with databases to store, retrieve, and manage data
- Collaborate with front-end developers on integration
- Debug backend issues and performance bottlenecks

What We're Looking For
- Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a program in Computer Science, IT, or similar
- Working knowledge of at least one backend language/framework (Node.js, Python/Django, Java/Spring, or similar)
- Basic understanding of databases like MySQL or MongoDB
- Familiarity with API design principles
- Own laptop and stable internet connection

Stipend: ₹13,500/month
Duration: 1–3 Months
Location: Remote (India)
Job Type: Full-Time Internship
Apply before 5th August to be considered for this opportunity.

jobs.title: Backend Developer Intern (Node.js, Python, REST APIs)
jobs.description:
Backend Developer Intern (Node.js, Python, REST APIs)

Medinex Workforce is looking for a Backend Developer Intern to support server-side application development, API integration, database operations, and software testing. This opportunity is designed for candidates who want practical experience building the systems and services that power web applications.

Job Type: Full-Time Internship
Work Mode: Remote
Duration: 1–3 Months
Stipend: ₹15,500 per month

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in developing backend features and application services
* Build and test REST API endpoints under technical guidance
* Connect backend services with relational or NoSQL databases
* Implement basic business logic and data-processing functions
* Investigate and resolve backend errors and integration issues
* Support API testing and functional verification
* Maintain technical documentation for assigned modules
* Collaborate with frontend developers and other technical team members

Qualifications

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Basic knowledge of Python, Node.js, Java, or another backend language
* Understanding of REST APIs and database fundamentals
* Familiarity with Git and version control is an advantage
* Academic or personal backend projects are welcome

Skills

* Strong logical reasoning and programming fundamentals
* Analytical approach to troubleshooting
* Understanding of APIs and data flow
* Attention to code quality and detail
* Good communication and teamwork
* Willingness to learn backend frameworks and development practices

What You Can Expect

* Practical exposure to backend application development
* Experience working with APIs, databases, and server-side logic
* Opportunity to contribute to structured software projects
* Collaboration with frontend and engineering teams
* Internship certificate subject to successful completion of the internship
